data.summary: The 8 Google reviews for Dynamis Roofing are all 5-star and contain authentic-seeming details about roofing projects and interactions with owner Brad. However, the perfect score from a small sample, the consistent focus on one person, and the complete absence of reviews on other platforms or any critical feedback are mild red flags. The reviews do not appear blatantly fake, but the pattern is atypical for a contractor with significant volume.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Multiple reviews mention the same owner (Brad) in a very positive, similar tone
Lack of reviews on other common platforms (Angi, Houzz, Yelp)

positive_evidence: Mentions of quality checks and follow-up (Review 1)
Implied standing behind work through descriptions of professionalism and quality

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (roof replacement, gutters, hail damage, insurance claims)
Reviews mention varied but plausible additional services (fence staining, power washing, window screens)
Different writing styles and lengths are present
Some reviews mention timelines and specific interactions (e.g., meeting the inspector)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary review source (Google) with a perfect rating. BBB has no rating or complaints. No other platforms have reviews, so there is no data to create a discrepancy.

reviews.text: Brad from Dynamis Roofing delivers even more than he promises! It’s a great approach considering moving factors of any project. With my complicated roof replacement situation under time pressure I’ve got a lot of good information from Brad and a reasonable plan how to achieve the best possible results. Adding smaller other jobs brought a complete solution to what was required. Well organized, managed on every step project was completed perfectly well and very quickly, plus checked for quality - no issues, the roof looks great. I appreciate expertise and diligent work, demonstrated by Brad and the crew. It’s also worth mentioning  that all precautions were taken to prevent any accidental damage, protect my flowerbeds and the pool. I can’t thank Brad enough and totally confident that he will do a great job with any service he provides!
reviews.author: Viktoriya Bushkova

reviews.text: Brad with Dynamis Roofing Contractors and his team were professional, knowledgeable, punctual, and efficient.  He was there from the beginning to end, even when the inspector came out.  His roofers and gutter guys did an excellent job.  We had other repairs to the house that were taking care of by another team of his that did a wonderful job as well.  Everyone was pleasant and addressed any questions I had throughout the whole process.  I would recommend Brad and his company, Dynamis Roofing Contractors to anyone.
reviews.author: Kathy Anderson

reviews.text:
Recently Dynamis fixed my flat roof, and I couldn't be happier with the results. From start to finish, their professionalism and attention to detail were outstanding. They provided a thorough inspection and explained all my options clearly.

The roofing team was punctual, efficient, and maintained a clean work site throughout the project. The quality of their work is top-notch; my new roof looks fantastic and has already weathered heavy raining without any issues.

Overall, I highly recommend this responsible roofer in the Dallas area. They deliver exceptional craftsmanship, reliability, and eco-consciousness – a five-star experience all around!
reviews.author: Katrina Tang

reviews.text: We recently worked with Brad and his company Dynamis Roofing to make some repairs to our home after some spring hail storms here in Little Elm. They replaced the roof, gutters, garage door, window screens, power washed and stained our fence and patio. Brad was such a pleasure to deal with. He was very professional and dealt with the insurance company to ensure everything was covered. His guys did excellent work and left our property clean and neat. I am a very picky person and like attention to detail. The quality of their work was great. It’s hard to find people now days that show up on time and do what they say they will. If you need a roof replaced don’t hesitate to give Dynamis Roofing a shout, and give Brad an opportunity to earn your business.
reviews.author: jeff lassiter

reviews.text: Had a great experience with Dynamis Roofing Contractors from their professionalism and their good work. He made everything so easy and stress  free.  Dynamic Roofing and there crew did a fabulous job from  finished my roof in one day to cleaned my yard and it looks GREAT!!!
reviews.author: Jerry Ballard

reviews.text: Dynamis did an exceptional job with replacing my roof and gutters, and repairing other damage caused by a hailstorm. Brad also helped with the insurance claim, negotiating on my behalf. The work was done on-time, on budget and at a very high quality. I would highly recommend Dynamis Roofing to any homeowner who wants the job done right the first time.
reviews.author: Elaine Wells

reviews.text:
I called Brad after the severe storm to inspect our roof and give us an estimate. It was such a fantastic experience working with him! He was right on time, not a minute late, just as we had discussed. He even gave me a heads up that he was on his way. In addition to the roof inspection, he provided some helpful general recommendations on what might need attention soon and reassured us that he wasn't trying to scam us.

I absolutely highly recommend Brad and his company!
reviews.author: Igor Novik

reviews.text:
This is our second time working with Brad and he always exceeds our expectations with his delivery.

We recently had to replace one of our rooftop vents and when I asked if Brad was able to fix this, he was able to quickly give us a quote and schedule us on next availability. He made sure we got our vent replaced before any rain was slated on the forecast.

We even asked around other roofers in the area and they were quoting us unrealistic prices compared to what Brad was quoting us. His estimate was honest and straightforward which I really appreciate.

The quality of his work is impeccable and we appreciate all that he has done for our roof. We will definitely be using his services again and will be relaying his business to our friends/family since he is one of the best roofers we've worked with in DFW.

Also he sends you photos of the work which is super appreciated!

100% highly recommend.
reviews.author: Kristi Muse
